name: ZX_CONDITION_DETAILS
description: This table stores Tax Condition Details

columns.name: CONDITION_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: CONDITION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: CONDITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Condition group code

columns.name: DETERMINING_FACTOR_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor class code

columns.name: DETERMINING_FACTOR_CQ_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor class qualifier code. This is a sub classification of the determining factor class.

columns.name: DETERMINING_FACTOR_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor code

columns.name: OPERATOR_CODE
columns.description: Operator used for defining the condition. Possible values are IN and NOT IN

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code

columns.name: TAX_PARAMETER_CODE
columns.description: Tax parameter code for the determining factor

columns.name: DATA_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the determining factor. Possible values are DATE, NUMERIC and ALPHANUMERIC.

columns.name: NUMERIC_VALUE
columns.description: Column for recording the numeric value to be compared with the determining factor

columns.name: DATE_VALUE
columns.description: Column for recording the date value to be compared with the determining factor

columns.name: ALPHANUMERIC_VALUE
columns.description: Column for recording the alphanumeric value to be compared with the determining factor

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of this record by a concurrent program

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record
